basisOfRecord.quote: We collected the data on Cerrado sensu stricto vegetation (tropical savanna) within the Área de Proteção Ambiental do Rio Pandeiros (APA Rio Pandeiros).
Field collections were performed in March 2016 during the hot and rainy season, the period of greatest ant activity in the Cerrado (Marques & Del-Claro, 2010).
We also collected individuals from the nests that performed the removals for subsequent species identification and measurement of morphological traits.
All measurements were obtained in millimetres under a Zeiss Axio Zoom V16 microscope.

measurementStatistic.quote: In species for which we sampled only one nest, only one individual was measured, whereas in species for which we sampled more than one nest, the mean of all individuals measured was calculated.
